description: Runs the N1.7 training container as a single AWS Batch job on the toolchain's GPU compute environment. Every setting travels as a containerOverrides.environment entry, matching training/gr00t/submit_batch_training_n17.py; the job definition is never re-registered.
inputInstructions:
Select the asset holding a LeRobot v2 dataset. The whole asset is staged to the toolchain's datasets bucket and validated with validate_lerobot_gr00t_dataset.py before the Batch job is submitted; a global batch size the job definition's GPU count cannot divide is rejected before submission. Checkpoints are written back to this asset under a per-run folder.

The Hugging Face token is read from the toolchain account's Secrets Manager (HF_TOKEN_SECRET_ID) at submit time; it is never a form field.

tagSchema.label: Global batch size
tagSchema.description: Must be divisible by the job definition's GPU count; the runner rejects a value that is not.

tagSchema.label: Embodiment
tagSchema.description: Modality configuration the N1.7 container loads (ur3_modality_config.py or g1_dex3_modality_config.py).

tagSchema.label: Tune the vision tower
tagSchema.description: Unfreezes the vision tower during fine-tuning. Slower; usually off.
